name: Dengdai Fuchou Ri
source:
The story takes place in a fictional world of sword and sorcery. The protagonist, Amelia, comes from a powerful family of magicians, yet she was exiled due to her complete lack of magical abilities. After being forced to move into a haunted house, she encounters the ghost of its former owner, and the story begins.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849180/]Steam[/url]]
